mapper.sql: r.id, r.reservation_no, r.move_request_id, mr.request_no, r.quote_id, q.quote_no, r.status, r.scheduled_start_at, r.scheduled_end_at, r.customer_memo, r.confirmed_at, r.cancelled_at, r.created_at, customer.name AS customer_name, customer.phone AS customer_phone, mr.origin_address, mr.destination_address, q.total_amount AS quote_total_amount, (SELECT ta.status FROM technician_assignment ta WHERE ta.reservation_id = r.id ORDER BY ta.assigned_at DESC, ta.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS technician_assignment_status, (SELECT ta.id FROM technician_assignment ta WHERE ta.reservation_id = r.id ORDER BY ta.assigned_at DESC, ta.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS technician_assignment_id, (SELECT technician.name FROM technician_assignment ta JOIN technician_profile tp ON tp.id = ta.technician_id JOIN app_user technician ON technician.id = tp.user_id WHERE ta.reservation_id = r.id ORDER BY ta.assigned_at DESC, ta.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS technician_name
FROM reservation r JOIN move_request mr ON mr.id = r.move_request_id JOIN quote q ON q.id = r.quote_id JOIN app_user customer ON customer.id = mr.customer_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ta.status FROM technician_assignment ta WHERE ta.reservation_id = r.id ORDER BY ta.assigned_at DESC, ta.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) current_assignment ON true
mapper.select: SELECT mr.customer_id, mr.status, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reservation r WHERE r.move_request_id = mr.id AND r.status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'RESCHEDULE_REQUESTED') ) AS has_active_reservation FROM move_request mr WHERE mr.id = #{requestId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler} FOR UPDATE OF mr

SELECT mr.customer_id, mr.status, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reservation r WHERE r.move_request_id = mr.id AND r.status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'RESCHEDULE_REQUESTED') ) AS has_active_reservation FROM move_request mr WHERE mr.id = #{requestId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}

INSERT INTO reservation ( id, reservation_no, move_request_id, quote_id, status, scheduled_start_at, scheduled_end_at, customer_memo, confirmed_at, idempotency_key, idempotency_request_hash ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, #{reservationNo}, #{requestId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, #{quoteId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, 'PENDING', #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{customerMemo}, null, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash} ) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET scheduled_start_at = #{startAt}, scheduled_end_at = #{endAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{reservationId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
mapper.select: UPDATE technician_assignment SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = now() WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'ON_THE_WAY') RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_event (id, assignment_id, event_type, note, created_by) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, #{assignmentId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, 'CANCELLED', #{reason}, #{actorId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler})
mapper.update: UPDATE move_request SET status = 'RESERVED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{requestId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'QUOTED'
UPDATE reservation SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{reservationId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
UPDATE move_request SET status = 'QUOTED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{requestId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'RESERVED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log ( id, actor_user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, before_summary, after_summary ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, #{actorId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, #{action}, 'RESERVATION', #{reservationId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, jsonb_build_object( 'status', CAST(#{beforeStatus} AS text) ), jsonb_build_object( 'status', CAST(#{afterStatus} AS text), 'scheduledStartAt', CAST(#{startAt} AS text), 'scheduledEndAt', CAST(#{endAt} AS text) ) )

INSERT INTO audit_log ( id, actor_user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, before_summary, after_summary ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, #{actorId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, #{action}, 'RESERVATION', #{reservationId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, jsonb_build_object( 'scheduledStartAt', CAST(#{beforeStartAt} AS text), 'scheduledEndAt', CAST(#{beforeEndAt} AS text) ), jsonb_build_object( 'scheduledStartAt', CAST(#{afterStartAt} AS text), 'scheduledEndAt', CAST(#{afterEndAt} AS text) ) )
mapper.select: WITH expired AS ( UPDATE reservation SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = now() WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND created_at <= #{cutoff} RETURNING id, move_request_id ) SELECT id, move_request_id FROM expired
